verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog docs show access control enforced whenever a table is queried and privileges granted on tables across a catalog.schema.object namespace, so table-level, grant-based governance is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents row filters, column masks, or dynamic masking policies, and an older community comment describes Databricks security as table-level only. missing for 10: documented row-level security, column-level masking policies, role/group-based policy evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of fine-grained controls.
